say:1:1730301201:1.text: They've never seen eye to eye on how to deal with the Bantus Empire.
say:1:1730301201:1.source_cn: 没错，他们两人对于班题斯帝国的态度一直都存在分歧。
say:1:1730301201:1.male: They've never seen eye to eye on how to deal with the Bantus Empire.
say:1:1730301201:1.female: They've never seen eye to eye on how to deal with the Bantus Empire.

say:2:1730301202:1.text: While the Queen favors diplomacy with the Bantus, Prince Orion backs the knights in waging war for the empire's interests.
say:2:1730301202:1.source_cn: 王后主张与班题斯帝国和谈，而奥利安殿下却支持骑士团攻打...
say:2:1730301202:1.male: While the Queen favors diplomacy with the Bantus, Prince Orion backs the knights in waging war for the empire's interests.
say:2:1730301202:1.female: While the Queen favors diplomacy with the Bantus, Prince Orion backs the knights in waging war for the empire's interests.

say:3:1730301203:1.text: Their conflict isn't personal but concerns the future of the Lightbearer Empire.
say:3:1730301203:1.source_cn: 这背后是整个耀光选择路径的分歧，和具体的人已经无关了。
say:3:1730301203:1.male: Their conflict isn't personal but concerns the future of the Lightbearer Empire.
say:3:1730301203:1.female: Their conflict isn't personal but concerns the future of the Lightbearer Empire.

say:5:1730301204:1.source_cn: 确实如此，我也听说了这件事。
